summary: Clackamas County, OR; USFS L-4 ground cab, built 1937 per FFLOS; a 1934 photo caption and a 1953 report date its loss differently; gone by 1957. No site description found.

facts.design: L-4 ground cab, set about 1/8 mile east of and below a minor summit
facts.status_note: FFLOS and firelookout.com say gone by 1957; a 1953 district report says it was condemned and destroyed that year; no source describes the site now

events.note: Panorama photo of the lookout captioned March 20, 1934, three years before the 1937 build date
Built by the USFS as an L-4 ground cab, about 1/8 mile east of and below a minor summit
Condemned and destroyed that year per a 1953 Estacada District historical report, quoted in a February 10, 1954 note; the loss left one full-time lookout in the district
Gone by 1957 per FFLOS and firelookout.com
Registered August 18, 2010, nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Unresolved: a 1934 panorama caption predates the 1937 build date, and the 1953 destruction note differs from the 1957 'gone by' date on FFLOS and firelookout.com. Staffing is inferred from the 1954 note that the loss left one full-time lookout in the district; the story no longer states that Eagle Creek itself was a full-time post, because the note does not say so. No access, present-day or photo-of-site information found; access omitted. The firelookout.org county list (type Ground, status Gone) agrees but was not cited.
